read.thesis: Volume-led growth with price falling: Q4 US price down 7% while 2026 guidance of $80-83B (about 25% growth) assumes low-to-mid-teens price drag, with incretin volume doing the work.

capex.quote: Since 2020, we've committed over $55 billion, the largest manufacturing build-out in company history.

triggers.label: US price down 7% YoY in Q4
triggers.quote: US revenue grew 43% in Q4, but the average price declined 7% year over year.

triggers.label: Incretin prescriptions up 33% YoY
triggers.quote: total prescriptions increasing by 33% compared to Q4 2024

triggers.label: 2026 revenue $80-83B, ~25% growth
triggers.quote: We expect revenue to be between $80 billion and $83 billion.

triggers.label: 2026 price drag low-to-mid teens
triggers.quote: Price is expected to be a drag on growth in the low to mid-teens.

guidance.quote: We expect revenue to be between $80 billion and $83 billion.
We expect our non-GAAP performance margin to be between 46% and 47.5%.
We expect earnings per share of between $33.50 and $35

red_flags.label: US price erosion 7% in Q4, 2026 price drag low-to-mid teens
red_flags.quote: the average price declined 7% year over year.

red_flags.label: Medicaid access reduction 2026
red_flags.quote: we anticipate a reduction in Medicaid access in 2026 due to key states like California removing obesity coverage.
